internet.description: Normal internet usage: everything on DHCP.

ssh-link.description: Direct ethernet cable to the Raspberry Pi for SSH. Wifi is left alone so this device keeps normal internet access.

peer-join.description: Join the Raspberry Pi's broadcast wifi network (see raspberrypi.json's peer-host scenario) directly over the air and set a static IP on the same subnet, for SSH when no shared router is available. Ethernet is left alone.
